FDA Chief Calls Actors Violators Over Vimal Pan Masala Ad

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Chief Tukaram Mundhe has declared actors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Tiger Shroff as "violators of law" for their endorsement of Vimal Pan Masala. Mundhe stated that these celebrities are not merely stars but are actively breaking the law by promoting the product. The FDA chief's remarks came in the context of the ongoing controversy surrounding the advertisement.
